entries.citation: Fla. Const. art. X, § 4(a)(1); Fla. Stat. §§ 222.01-222.02
entries.description: Homestead: residence of the owner or owner's family — unlimited value; limited to 1/2 acre of contiguous land within a municipality or 160 contiguous acres outside one
entries.notes: Value-unlimited but acreage-limited. Subject in bankruptcy to 11 U.S.C. § 522(p)/(q) caps for recently acquired or misconduct-tainted homesteads. The flsenate.gov constitution page could not be machine-read at build time; text verified against mirrors — re-verify against the official page before first filing.
Constitutional figure, unchanged since the 1968 revision; doubles in practice for joint filers as each spouse claims it. Same build-time mirror caveat as fl-homestead.
Raised from $1,000.00 by ch. 2024-110, eff. 2024-07-01. A case filed before that date needs the old figure; none can still be prepared in this product, so the historical row is omitted.

entries.description: Professionally prescribed health aids for the debtor or a dependent
Personal property of any kind — ONLY if the debtor does not claim or receive the benefit of the homestead exemption
entries.notes: Conditional, not a carryover: available instead of, never alongside, the homestead benefit. Enacted 2007; amendment date of the current figure not separately verified — the figure itself is the current statute text.

entries.description: Disposable earnings of a head of family (provides more than half the support of a child or other dependent)
entries.notes: No flat cap: earnings <= $750.00/week are fully exempt; above that, exempt absent a written waiver (14-point type, separate document). Non-head-of-family earnings get only federal CCPA limits (15 U.S.C. § 1673). Exemption follows earnings into a bank account for 6 months if traceable.

entries.description: Cash surrender value of life insurance policies and proceeds of annuity contracts issued to Florida residents
entries.notes: Not exempt against a creditor the policy or contract was effected for the benefit of.

entries.description: Assets in tax-qualified retirement plans and accounts (IRC §§ 401(a), 403(a)/(b), 408, 408A, 409, 414, 457(b), 501(a)), including inherited IRAs
